name: scrub-bar-seeks
description: Dragging the Quick timeline to its midpoint moves the VideoSession playhead to the midpoint of the duration.

steps.name: durationKnown
steps.note: The timeline fraction uses the session's duration, so wait until the stream reports its length before seeking.
Paused first, so the seek target is held still and can be compared as a number. Left running, time-pos would race past the assertion and this scenario would measure the clock rather than the seek.
A press at the midpoint is the real Quick timeline gesture: it must seek the live controller session without a direct property write.
Bounded settle for the seek to land in the core; the assertions below carry the scenario.

assertions.note: The Quick timeline sends its midpoint press to the live session; the paused source position must land halfway through this fixture.
Pins the constant the previous assertion is computed from, so a fixture or load problem reports as its own failure instead of quietly invalidating the expected 6.0.
The Quick timeline's displayed fraction agrees with the paused core position.
A seek is announced through the surface's position signal, which is how the dock's own labels follow it.
